questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of logic synthesis?
options: It converts an RTL to an equivalent netlist (interconnection of logic gates)
It converts an RTL to an equivalent algorithm in C
It converts an RTL to a technology library in Liberty
It converts an RTL to a constraint in SDC
questions.accepted: It converts an RTL to an equivalent netlist (interconnection of logic gates)

questions.prompt: Which of the following information is typically NOT needed by a logic synthesis tool:
options: RTL design [in Verilog or VHDL]
Constraints [in Synopsys Design Constraint (SDC) format]
Simulation output [in Value Change Dump (VCD) format]
Technology Library [in Liberty format]
questions.accepted: Simulation output [in Value Change Dump (VCD) format]

questions.prompt: What is the interface of a library cell or cell instance of a design called
options: Via
Pin
Jack
Port

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of physical design in VLSI design flow?
options: It creates a library for a given netlist
It creates an algorithm for a given netlist
It creates a testbench for a given netlist
It creates a layout for a given netlist
questions.accepted: It creates a layout for a given netlist

questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks is not a part of the physical design:
options: Placement
Routing
Clock tree synthesis
RTL synthesis

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of verification in VLSI design flow?
options: It ensures that the design makes a customer happy
It ensures that the design works as per the given functionality
It ensures that the design attracts many customers
It ensures that the design makes a lot of profit
questions.accepted: It ensures that the design works as per the given functionality

questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks is not a kind of design verification task:
options: Floorplanning
Static Timing Analysis
Combinational Equivalence Checking
RTL Simulation

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of the manufacturing test?
options: It ensures that the design is made as per the functionality
It ensures that the yield of the process is high
It ensures that no one can make a pirated chip out of the manufactured chip
It checks whether the manufactured chip has a fatal defect.
questions.accepted: It checks whether the manufactured chip has a fatal defect.

questions.prompt: Yield for a chip reduces when:
options: Defect density is decreased by better process control
Probability of introducing random defects during fabrication is decreased
The area of a die is increased
The area of a die is decreased
questions.accepted: The area of a die is increased

questions.prompt: Which of the following techniques is NOT a resolution enhancement technique:
options: Optical proximity correction
Dummy metal fill
Double-patterning
Multi-patterning
